metadata.description: Computer use in the background for Claude Code: your Android phone, your Windows desktop apps, your real Chrome, a direct line to Codex and Antigravity, your Logitech keypad. Each plugin connects to its product's native Windows engine (no Python), installed by NexusSystem.

plugins.name: nexus-android
plugins.description: Android phone over plain ADB (no root, no app): screen, gestures, SMS/RCS, notifications, files, settings. Served by the local NexusAndroid daemon, installed by NexusSystem (or NexusAndroid's get.ps1); needs USB debugging on the phone.

plugins.name: nexus-windows
plugins.description: Windows desktop apps through native UI Automation: observe, click, type, menus, shortcuts and launch. Foreground interaction is explicit when required. Starts the native NexusWindows engine installed by NexusSystem (or NexusWindows' get.ps1).

plugins.name: nexus-browser
plugins.description: Your real Chrome (your sessions) driven in background tabs: forms, network, dialogs, cross-origin iframes, exports, downloads. Served by the local NexusBrowser daemon; requires its Chrome extension, both installed by NexusSystem (or NexusBrowser's get.ps1).

plugins.name: nexus-relay
plugins.description: Direct link between Claude, Codex and Antigravity on one Windows PC: topic rooms, multi-agent review, delegated tasks. Served by the local NexusRelay daemon, installed by NexusSystem (or NexusRelay's get.ps1).

plugins.name: nexus-keypad
plugins.description: NexusKeypad in Claude: live states for the Logitech keypad (hooks), exact usage (5-hour and weekly) and, under the prompt, whether Codex and Antigravity are reachable through Nexus Relay. No alert, no network. Needs NexusKeypad, installed by NexusSystem (or NexusKeypad's get.ps1).
